description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {4}.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Grim Monolith's last ability.
Resolve the copy of Grim Monolith's last ability, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Grim Monolith ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.
